verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਆਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal dhiaa kai dhikhaavai jaeh taeh aan roop ra(n)g dhekhe naahee bhaaviee ||

en.bdb: One who is blessed by Satguru with spiritual wisdom, he does not like to see any other form or attraction. Nothing else can give tranquility and peace to such a blessed person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਇਆ ਕੈ ਚਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal miaa kai chakhaavai jaeh taeh an ras nahee(n) rasanaa hitaaviee ||

en.bdb: One who is blessed with spiritual pleasure by the True Guru, he does not relish any other pleasures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal agahu gahaavai jaeh sarab nidhaan parasan kau na dhaaviee ||

en.bdb: A devout Sikh who is blessed with the spiritual pleasure that no one can reach to, he need not run after other worldly relishments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਵਾਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakhaavai jaeh akath kathaa binodh vaahee ban aaviee ||20||

en.bdb: Only he who is blessed with self-realization (spiritual knowledge) can feel its pleasure and this cannot be explained. The devotee himself can only appreciate the pleasure of that state. (20)
